entities.summary: Tyrone Jeremy Grant is an American former professional basketball player and now CEO of Team First Inc as well as Wave Holistic Health. At a height of 2.02 m tall, he played at the small forward and power forward positions. He was an explosive scorer and good rebounder. Grant has 2 children who are athletes, Tyra and Tyson.
